title: 第二十四章 Ｃ区
content_zh:
哈哈哈哈~

    一长串的狂笑在C区的某个房间中回响，只是撞到墙壁之后又弹了回来，完全传不出去。

    “你笑够没有？”妖媚的女子瞪着双眼，冲着对面被捆在椅子上的女孩子怒不可遏的大吼。

    “没有！”对方并不像是一个善于笑，或者说经常笑的女孩，可是在这个时候，她就是想笑，因为她笑的越高兴，对方就越是不高兴，有时候真是什么都是有目的的，就连这笑也是一样。

    “你！”女子恨的直咬牙。

    “你找我来就是为了让我看这些小水怪的表演？”女孩收了笑，不过嘴角的那丝不屑更是明显，“表演是不错，不过只能说明这些水怪比较聪明，而不是它们的主人。”

    “你……”女子气的直跺脚，“你别以为只有这些小玩意儿，既然带你来了C区，别想着可以舒舒服服的离开。”

    “离开？”女孩裂了裂嘴，“进来都不容易，干嘛要离开？”

    “好！有你受的！”女子一气之下，甩门走人，一出门正好撞上了凯罗，凯罗难得来一趟Ｃ区，所以见到他的女子不由的一愣，而凯罗更是一惊，毕竟出现在这里，总是有些目的的，不过他的反应远比对方来的快，以极完美的弧度收身避开，“爱夏，什么时候你变得这么不优雅啦？”

    “你……”爱夏唬着脸，心情极差的瞪了对方两眼，“别跟我说话！小心我拿你喂蚊蝇！”

    “算了！我闭嘴！”凯罗双手捂嘴，不再出声，要知道这个蚊蝇可不是人类社会，或者说自然界中偶尔喝点小血，闲时拢人清梦的小东西，就算不知道是什么，光是听爱夏的口气就知道，对方肯定不小，至少可以将凯罗吞食，至于什么其它的爱好，这个凯罗也只是听说，听说见过蚊蝇的人，或者说贵族，早就销声匿迹了，连一小颗沙粒都没留下。

    爱夏见凯罗乖乖的闭嘴，也没多说什么，转身打算离开，可是凯罗一转身，只见对面关着的门角处还有水样的东西在溢出来，凯罗觉得不对劲，回身想要叫住爱夏问个清楚，“爱夏，这里……”

    可是爱夏的回眸足以让他再次闭嘴，然后背对着对方，任对方离开。

    “她又在搞什么鬼？”凯罗好奇加疑惑，本来的目的，加上现在的好奇心，又让他向前迈出了两步，可是两步之后呢！原地站着，思考着，对面是爱夏的实验室，那些可怕的虫子都是出自那里，所以任谁也不会轻易踏进里面，除非他不想活了，而且还不想死的太舒服，可是不入虎穴焉得虎子。

    “凯罗？”

    “啊！”正当凯罗想的出神，突然肩后伸出一只手来，在他的右肩上打了个招呼，吓了他一跳，回头，“原来是你啊！维斯！”

    “怎么啦？”维斯打量着凯罗，“刚才看见爱夏一路气呼呼的出去，完全无视我的招呼，现在你道好，到是把我吓了一跳！”

    “没什么！”凯罗不想有更多的人参与进来，毕竟有时候知道的人多了，可利用的价值就相对变弱了，而且他的真实身份也会暴露。

    “没什么才怪！”结果维斯可不是个有头无脑的粗人，“快说！不然等下我就去告诉爱夏，说你偷偷的进了她的实验室！”

    “你……”凯罗有种被打劫的感觉。

    “快说吧！”维斯笑着得意。

    “算了！告诉你也没什么，我刚才见到爱夏从里面气呼呼的出来，我想原因就在里面，只是……”凯罗很想进去，可是独自又有点害怕，虽然自身实力不低，可是这种地方，实力也许只是一个毫无意义的名词。现在虽然多了个人，但是有坏处也有好处。

    “你想进去？”维斯自然不笨，而且向来知道凯罗的好奇心极强，他站在门前一动不动，如果不是想进去，那就是傻了。

    “你也想进去？”凯罗转身望着维斯，一脸的欢迎。

    “不想。”结果维斯回答的毫不犹豫。

    “你可从来都没有进去过？你就不想进去看看，里面到时有些什么东西？为什么爱夏可以造出那么多的虫子，而且一种比一种可怕。”凯罗不停的游说着一旁的维斯，“说不定我们还能找到对付那些虫子的办法呢！到时我们就不用怕她了，至少不用被她要挟。”

    “这……”几分钟后，维斯开始变得犹豫不决，看着眼前那道不过五十厘米宽的小门，黑黑的，到处都是虫子爬过的痕迹，如果可以，他永生永世都不想用任何一只手，一根指尖去碰触。

    “放心！这门我来开。”凯罗观察力极强，一眼便看出了维斯的犹豫所在，最后十分慷慨的保证道。
content_en:
Hahahaha~

    A long string of wild laughter echoed in a certain room in Area C, but it bounced back after hitting the wall, unable to spread at all.

    "Have you smiled enough?" The charming woman glared and yelled angrily at the girl who was tied to the chair opposite.

    "No!" The other person doesn't seem to be a girl who is good at laughing, or laughs often, but at this time, she just wants to laugh, because the happier she laughs, the unhappy the other person becomes. Sometimes everything has a purpose, even this smile is the same.

    "You!" The woman gritted her teeth in hatred.

    "You came here just to let me watch the performance of these little water monsters?" The girl stopped smiling, but the disdain on the corner of her mouth was even more obvious. "The performance is good, but it only shows that these water monsters are smarter, not their owners."

    "You..." the woman stomped her feet angrily, "Don't think that these gadgets are all you have. Since I brought you to Area C, don't think that you can leave comfortably."

    "Leave?" The girl cracked her mouth, "It's not easy to come in, so why leave?"

    "Okay! It's your fault!" The woman was so angry that she slammed the door and left. As soon as she went out, she bumped into Kailuo. Kailuo rarely came to Area C, so the woman who saw him couldn't help but was stunned, and Kailuo was even more shocked. After all, there is always some purpose for appearing here. However, his reaction was much faster than the other party's, and he avoided it with a perfect arc, "Aisha, when did you become so ungraceful?"

    "You..." Ai Xia bluffed and glared at the other person in a very bad mood, "Don't talk to me! Be careful I feed you to mosquitoes and flies!"

    "Forget it! I shut up!" Kailuo covered his mouth with both hands and stopped making any sound. You must know that this mosquito is not a human society, or a little thing in nature that occasionally drinks a little blood and makes people dream in their spare time. Even if they don't know what it is, they just listen to Ai Xia. He knew from his tone that the other party was definitely not small, and could at least devour Kailuo. As for other hobbies, Kailuo had only heard that people who had seen mosquitoes and flies, or nobles, had long since disappeared without leaving even a grain of sand.

    Ai Xia saw Kai Luo obediently shut up and didn't say anything. She turned around and was about to leave. However, when Kai Luo turned around, she saw something watery overflowing from the corner of the closed door opposite. Kai Luo felt something was wrong and turned around to stop Ai Xia to ask clearly, "Ai Xia, here..."

    But Ai Xia's look back was enough to make him shut up again, then turn his back to the other person and let him leave.

    "What the hell is she doing?" Kailo was curious and confused. His original purpose and current curiosity made him take two steps forward, but what happened after two steps! Standing on the spot, thinking, opposite is Aisha's laboratory. Those terrible bugs come from there, so no one will easily step into it, unless he doesn't want to live anymore, and he doesn't want to die too comfortably, but you can't catch the tiger's den without entering the tiger's den.

    "Kyro?"

    "Ah!" Just as Kairo was lost in thought, a hand suddenly stretched out from behind his shoulder and said hello on his right shoulder. He was startled and turned around, "So it's you! Weiss!"

    "What's wrong?" Weiss looked at Kailuo, "I just saw Aisha walking out angrily and completely ignoring my greetings. Now you say hello, it really shocked me!"

    "Nothing!" Kailuo didn't want more people to get involved. After all, sometimes the more people knew about it, the less valuable it could be, and his true identity would also be exposed.

    "It's nothing strange!" It turns out that Weiss is not a brainless man. "Say it quickly! Otherwise, I will tell Aisha later that you secretly entered her laboratory!"

    "You..." Kailuo felt like he was being robbed.

    "Say it!" Weiss smiled proudly.

    "Forget it! It's okay to tell you. I just saw Aisha coming out of it in anger. I think the reason is inside, but..." Kailuo really wanted to go in, but he was a little scared alone. Although his own strength was not low, in a place like this, strength might just be a meaningless term. Although there are more people now, there are disadvantages and advantages.

    "You want to go in?" Weiss is not stupid, and he has always known that Kailuo is very curious. He stood motionless in front of the door. If he didn't want to go in, he would be stupid.

    "You want to go in too?" Kairo turned and looked at Weiss with a welcoming look on his face.

    "I don't want to." Weiss answered without hesitation.

    "You've never been in there before? Don't you want to go in and see what's inside? Why can Aisha create so many bugs, and each one is scarier than the last." Kailuo kept persuading Weiss, "Maybe we can still find a way to deal with those bugs! Then we don't have to be afraid of her, at least we don't have to be blackmailed by her."

    "This..." After a few minutes, Weiss began to become hesitant, looking at the small door in front of him, which was only fifty centimeters wide. It was dark and full of traces of insects crawling. If he could, he would never want to touch it with any hand or fingertip.

    "Don't worry! I'll open this door." Kailuo was very observant and could see Weiss's hesitation at a glance, and finally promised generously.
